title: A Taxonomy of Response Strategies to Toxic Online Content: Evaluating the Evidence
benchmark_measurement: The paper identifies and evaluates 'using religious teachings, values, and language' as one of 25 response strategies to toxic online content (TOC). It also notes that prejudice against religious groups is a form of TOC.
models_tested: Civic Health Project's Normsy AI chatbot
findings: Using religious teachings, values, and language is identified as an emerging response strategy to toxic online content, promoted by religious actors and influencers. This strategy reframes toxic discourse by drawing on shared moral principles (e.g., dignity, compassion) and may help protect youth and counter the misuse of religion by extremists. The paper also identifies religious groups like Muslims and Jews as common targets of prejudice in toxic online content.
